title: Select output caching from current tenant policy
goal: Resolve named output-cache policies dynamically when tenant settings change, keeping cache entries separated by tenant and policy revision.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: ASP.NET Core 11 supplies the new surface; exact observed runtime is RC2, not GA evidence.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the net11.0 application with an SDK supporting that target; sample pin is 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared canonical sample mode; older comparison uses C# 14 with SDK 10.0.402.

packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App net11.0 shared framework and Microsoft.NETCore.App runtime assets. The comparison uses corresponding net10.0 assets. No separate package for the new API.
providers: Kestrel loopback HTTP server; process-local state only. No account, database or remote service.
platforms: ASP.NET Core supported server platforms; actually executed on Windows x64 only. No browser/WASI, native, AOT or cross-platform execution claim.
renderingModes: Server HTTP endpoints; no Blazor rendering mode.
prerequisites: Save each complete sample in its own directory with the shown SDK/project/build/package files. Restore framework packs before executing. The installed guidance is offline.
constraints: The provider receives a policy name, not HttpContext or cancellation. Use request context deliberately; never keep tenant state in singleton fields. Named-policy resolution can run in several stages: snapshot once per request. Partition public output by tenant and revision; changing policy does not evict existing cache entries. Every enable/disable transition must increase the revision or a prior entry can revive until expiry. Unknown tenants bypass caching. This example caches only unauthenticated GET/HEAD 200 responses without Set-Cookie; it is not a private-data cache or an authorization boundary.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API intent prepared from pinned .NET 11 RC2 artifacts under ADR 0004; GA reconciliation remains pending. No experimental opt-in applies.

evidence.scope: Actual Windows x64 .NET 10.0.13 compilation and execution: 11 loopback HTTP requests, 7 handler executions, tenant isolation, cache hits, disable/re-enable, revision invalidation and unknown-station bypass through a registered custom IOutputCachePolicy. One rule read per request.

Actual Windows x64 .NET 11 RC2 compilation and execution: 11 loopback HTTP requests, 7 handler executions, tenant isolation, cache hits, disable/re-enable, revision invalidation and unknown-station bypass through IOutputCachePolicyProvider. One rule read per request despite multiple named-policy stages.

humanProof.scope: Focused HTTP behavior runs locally without owner-only resources. Does not settle product-wide client/platform coverage or GA/publication gates.
